text: Trying NED with the name as given.

NED's resolver returned nothing for that string -- it indexes catalog designations, and a colloquial name is not one. Re-sending the same string would fail identically, so I am translating it first. The Cat's Paw Nebula is NGC 6334.
The colloquial name failed at NED's resolver, as expected. Retrying with the formal designation NGC 6334 succeeded: NED holds 214 photometry rows for it, written in full to {{artifact:1}}.
